verdict.rationale: dlt provides a broad, maintained catalog of verified sources for REST APIs (with declarative rest_api source and OpenAPI generator), SQL databases across many SQLAlchemy dialects (Postgres, MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server, BigQuery, Snowflake, etc.), and file/cloud storage (S3, GCS, Azure, SFTP, local), plus 8000+ community/AI-generated sources referenced via llms.txt, and a wide range of destinations including warehouses, lakes, and vector stores like LanceDB. Community feedback corroborates ease of connecting APIs to databases as a core strength. Missing for 10: independent verification of connector maintenance/quality at scale, and clearer evidence of long-term maintenance cadence for the 'verified sources' catalog beyond vendor docs.
